answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 93 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes an island bet on surviving 93 epochs of grading, and every ripple settlement recomputes the zenith schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 14 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
